claim: Patchline draws an evaluation sample stratified by migration-pattern type so that rare but high-impact patterns are guaranteed representation, instead of being washed out by a naive uniform draw dominated by common cases. The worker groups the population by stratum and deterministically selects at least one item from every stratum, then verifies that each stratum — including the singleton rare pattern — appears in the sample. The gate proves the stratified sample covers all strata while a provided uniform sample misses the rare stratum entirely.
